scope: S0 technical protocol and cache qualification only; no issuer research or scores
user_paid_experiment_authorization: Existing user authorization for model/search experiments and continuation with budget notice
probe_order: model-produced lookup function call with stable prefix A
actual tool result continuation, if previous step returned one valid lookup call
new session with stable prefix A and fixed record question
exact repeat of fixed record request A
third exact fixed record request A
same fixed record question with prefix B first-character control
missing_key: record unavailable without attempting alternate credentials
unpriced_or_unknown_outcome: retain reservation and stop that model; no blind resend
cache_cold_state: unknown unless observed; do not infer independent cold samples
accuracy_claim: Only deterministic protocol fixtures, never financial accuracy
retention: safe final content, validated function arguments, hashes, counters and timing only; hidden reasoning stays in memory

price_basis.kind: official published USD rate-card estimate; actual billed cash and grants unknown
price_basis.deepseek_peak_utc: Monday-Friday 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00; otherwise off-peak; receipt interval straddling a boundary stays unpriced
